722010101.text: Ah, kind passers-by, please, please take pity on me...

722010104.text: Thank you, thank you for listening to these old bones pour out their woes... *sigh* Come here, come here, do let me say a little more...

722010105.text: I have not seen my life take a single good turn, not ever...

722010106.text: When I was but a newborn, the presiding priest accidentally knocked a lamp over, burning all the long hair on my aunt's head.

722010108.text: Later, I contracted some strange illness, and from then on suffered from a chronic ungainliness. Still later on, I fell from my cradle, breaking six ribs...

722010109.text: And when I grew a little older, my father hit me over the head with his shovel by mistake as he fought to save my cousin, who had almost choked to death on mushrooms...

722010110.text: And then there was the time when my beloved finch was eaten by the Wen Kamuy our family kept, before that same Wen Kamuy was knocked off a cliff by a boar...

722010111.text: After that, the girl I liked accidentally sacrificed the priest to the Great Thunderbird, and she was exiled from the island...

722010112.text: When I grew up, my grandma died from grief at my ugliness and gloominess, and my grandpa soon followed...

722010114.text: You could at least take comfort in your family, right?

722010115.text: Ah, speaking of my family... When I came of age, our witch doctor told me that I wouldn't be able to have children, because I'd grown a... One moment, let me show you...

722010201.text: Ah-hahahahah! Ah my, ah me... I'm all out of breath...

722010202.text: Ahaha... I'm tearing up over here! Ah, dear Chikapu, if only you were here to see this!

722010205.text: Hahaha... I'm sorry, I'm sorry. Please, don't be angry...

722010206.text: I and my wife have always enjoyed playing pranks on others. We've never pulled the same trick twice, you know? And everyone enjoyed them, too!

722010207.text: Later, she suffered from a serious illness and left this world early... She told me then that I had to play a trick on someone in front of her grave, or her spirit wouldn't be able to move on...

722010208.text: So I did. It was Chikapu's wish. How did it go? Pretty good, huh?

722010301.text: Go to Chirai Shrine. Her grave should be right beside it...
